title: Two 1904 jaunts open at the Fort Dearborn monument
items: The Bronze at Eighteenth Street jaunt, and each of its retellings for younger and older readers, can now be walked. It visits Rohl-Smith's 1893 monument where it stood on 18th Street by Calumet Avenue.
The Every Building Modelled So Far jaunt, which stops at the monument, can now be walked too.
